item.title: 'TBATS On The Go,' mapapanood na simula March 1 (Teaser)
item.description: Saan man tayo mapadpad, sama-sama tayo sa kulitan at tawanan! Tara na sa roadtrip sa 'TBATS On The Go.' Abangan ang 'TBATS On The Go' ngayong March 1, 10:05 p.m., sa GMA pagkatapos ng 'Kapuso Mo, Jessica Soho.' Mapapanood din ito online via Kapuso Stream.

item.title: Kris Bernal opens up about her postpartum journey
item.description: Actress Kris Bernal is no stranger to postpartum. In an interview with GMA Pinoy TV Podcast hosted by Tonie Pua, Kris shares the struggles she went through after giving birth in 2023.

item.title: Kris Bernal on doing Athena in House of Lies: "Ang daming layers ng character ko"
item.description: Coming off a three-year hiatus from teleseryes, Kris Bernal admitted she had real doubts about returning to acting when she accepted the role of Althea in House of Lies, a GMA Afternoon Prime drama.

item.title: Kris Bernal to Global Pinoys: "Sana po hindi kayo magsawa"
item.description: 'House of Lies' star Kris Bernal, thankful to Global Pinoys who continued to support her even after her three-year hiatus.

item.title: Hating Kapatid: Secrets (Teaser)
item.description: Buong buhay ni Belle (Cassy Legaspi), may pagkukulang dahil sa sikretong matagal nang ibinaon. Paano kung ang kulang ay malapit lang pala sa kanya? Subaybayan ang 'Hating Kapatid,' Lunes hanggang Sabado, 2:30 p.m., sa GMA Afternoon Prime. Mapapanood din ito online via Kapuso Stream.

item.title: First edition of 'El Filibusterismo' sold for P21M at auction
item.description: The first edition of 'El Filibusterismo' contains a sign and dedication from Dr. Jose Rizal.

item.title: This Feng Shui artist brings good fortune and prosperity to life through art
item.description: Curated by esteemed art connoisseur Nestor Jardin, this 24-piece art collection titled Spectrum of Abundance is a solo exhibit by Lizanne Uychaco, celebrated as the country's first and only Feng Shui artist.

item.title: Solenn Heussaff, Anne Curtis, friends in Shanghai for Georgina Wilson's birthday
item.description: The “It Girls” reunited in Shanghai, China, along with their other friends, to celebrate Georgina Wilson's 40th birthday in an elegantly fashionable way. In an Instagram post, It's Showtime host Anne Curtis said, “We all made it to Shanghai to celebrate our very own loved one @ilovegeorgina.” Meanwhile, Solenn Heussaff mused on how the trip reminded them that love and conversations are more than what they need in their 40s.
